function.name: get_top_cases
function.description: Retrieve a list of the most influential or landmark cases in a specific field of law. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

field_of_law.description: The specific field of law e.g., constitutional law, criminal law, etc.

top_number.description: The number of top cases to retrieve.

country.description: The country where the law cases should be retrieved from. Default is US.

function.name: math_gcd
function.description: Calculate the greatest common divisor of two integers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
